'''Pokémon Adventures: Agatha's Arbok''' is the thirty-third monthly issue released by [[VIZ Media]] of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga created by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and [[Mato]]. It contains chapters twenty-nine, thirty, and thirty-one of the {{MangaArc|Yellow}}. The chapters originally released in this book were later rereleased as part of {{PAV|6}}. As a bonus, it contained a sheet of Pokémon stickers which were not included with the collected volume release.
